name: Lizardfolk Fighter (CR 4)
body:
LIZARDFOLK FIGHTER
CR 4

XP 1,200
Lizardfolk fighter 4
CN Medium humanoid (reptilian)
Init +2; Senses Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 47 (6 HD; 2d8+4d10+16)
Fort +9, Ref +3, Will +1 (+1 vs. fear)
Defensive Abilities bravery +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 15 ft.
Melee +1 morningstar +10 (1d8+5), claw +9 (1d4+4), bite +9 (1d6+4), tail swipe +8 (1d4+2)
Ranged light crossbow +7 (1d8/19–20)
Special Attacks dangerous tail

TACTICS

During Combat The lizardfolk had their +1 morningstars confiscated by the npc, so they only fight with their natural attacks, flanking the heaviest-armored opponent, if possible, while dealing nonlethal damage.

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +9; CMD 21
Feats Dangerous Tail, Multiattack, Point-Blank Shot, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (tail swipe), Weapon Focus (tail swipe)
Skills Acrobatics +10, Intimidate +4, Perception +4, Swim +17; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ armor training 1, hold breath; leather armor, +1 morningstar, light crossbow with 20 bolts, 45 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dangerous Tail (Ex)

Roog & Targuhl have practiced using their tails as potent weapons. If used as part of a fullattack action, they make the attack at their full BAB. If a critical hit against a target with a tail swipe is confirmed, a trip combat maneuver attempt can be made against that target as a free action.
